ValidationRule.description: This validation rule checks if the start date selected is not the past date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'Digital Hub')), NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c < Today(), OR( ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c) ), NOT(ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Previous date cannot be selected as a Out Of Office start date
